title: The Elders of Nezonya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Kiddushin 25a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.25a.2-3) they did not come to Rav Chisda’s lecture. He said to Rav Hamnuna: “Go and excommunicate them.” They said to him: “Not Hamnuna but Karnuna.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Kiddushin 25a has לפירקיה, supporting “lecture” for the supplied לפיקריה. צנעינהו is rendered “excommunicate them” following the episode’s interpreted sense; that lexical interpretation is distinct from a claim of printed-letter correction history.

[Rashi](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Kiddushin.25a.2.2) explains the command as a respectful form of placing a scholar under a ban by telling him to stay at home. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2767&lang=en) records the elders’ absence and Rav Chisda’s instruction.
